name: app-6aa191664d448191b6646015b0fefe94
description: ACA (Automated Client Acquisition) connector and skills for ChatGPT: workspace setup guidance, contacts, lead lists, LinkedIn campaign and lead-magnet drafts, campaign results, replies, and content planning, through one OAuth sign-in.

interface.longDescription:
ACA helps go-to-market teams run client acquisition from one connected workspace. Check what the workspace has set up and the recommended next steps; search contacts, lead lists, conversations, sequences, campaigns, and campaign metrics; list connected LinkedIn and social accounts and CRM pipeline stages; create contacts, lead lists, content ideas, blueprints, agent profiles, and inactive LinkedIn campaign and lead-magnet drafts. Start content generation from existing active blueprints using external AI providers; generated content remains unapproved and unpublished.

Limitations: the app never sends messages, activates campaigns, or enrolls leads. Drafts are reviewed and activated in the ACA web app, where users also connect accounts and mailboxes and find new prospects. It only accesses the single workspace the user authorizes through OAuth. Contact changes may trigger configured webhooks, and adding contacts to a list can trigger that list's existing enrichment, enrollment, and outreach automations, so review the target list settings first.

positive.description: Find contacts in the review workspace.
positive.prompt: Find contacts at Acme in ACA and summarize likely decision makers.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns concise, paginated matching contacts from the authorized workspace only.

positive.description: Inspect an individual contact after selection.
positive.prompt: Show the ACA contact details and recent engagement for Taylor at Acme.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the selected contact and returns that contact's details and recent engagement.

positive.prompt: Which ACA outreach sequences are active? Give me a short summary of Q4 SaaS.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns bounded sequence summaries and the requested sequence's summary and step count.

positive.description: Triage an inbound reply without sending a message.
positive.prompt: Find ACA conversations with an inbound reply from Taylor and summarize the next follow-up needed.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the conversation and a concise follow-up summary without sending or modifying messages.
